2026-09-20 Riya asked if friend Diego's landlord can raise rent 6% in January (1990s Annex building): 2027 Ontario guideline is 2.5%; above-guideline needs LTB approval via form L5 (max 3% over guideline per year, up to 3 years); 90 days' notice on form N1; if no L5 filed, Diego pays 2.5%. Summary prepared for Diego.

CP trains), no child price on 24h passes (under 4 free, 4-12 reduced singles); Lisboa Card 24h EUR 27/48h 44/72h 54, child 24h EUR 17, worth it for one Belém day (Jerónimos EUR 18 + Belém Tower EUR 8). Added 'Getting around' section to Lisbon note.
